NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 136

He said (that) he… He told me (that) he…

他（曾）说他…… 他（曾）告诉我说他……

A picture lesson on reported speech with 'would' and 'would have to'. Twelve pictures in four groups of three show direct speech being converted to reported speech using 'would', 'might', 'could', and 'had to'. The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 135 conversation using reported speech), B (answer 'What did he/she say?' with 'He/She said (that)…'), and C (answer 'What did he/she tell you?' with 'He/She told me (that)…'). The workbook drills reported-speech completion for short conversations and open-ended 'About you' writing; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences with 'said'/'told' and 'would', completes a reported-speech dialogue, and writes short reports from given facts.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. I will be at home at 6.
2. What did she say? What did she tell you?
3. She said (that) she would be at home at 6. She told me (that) she would be at home at 6.
4. I may come home early.
5. What did she say? What did she tell you?
6. She said (that) she might come home early. She told me (that) she might come home early.
7. I can run very fast.
8. What did she say? What did she tell you?
9. She said (that) she could run very fast. She told me (that) she could run very fast.
10. I have to go to school.
11. What did she say? What did she tell you?
12. She said (that) she had to go to school. She told me (that) she had to go to school.

1. 我6点在家。 2. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 3. 她（说）她6点在家。她告诉我（说）她6点在家。 4. 我可能早点回家。 5. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 6. 她（说）她可能早点回家。她告诉我（说）她可能早点回家。 7. 我能跑得很快。 8. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 9. 她（说）她能跑得很快。她告诉我（说）她能跑得很快。 10. 我不得不去上学。 11. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 12. 她（说）她不得不去上学。她告诉我（说）她不得不去上学。

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

Practice A: Complete the conversations (reported speech)

What did these people say? Complete these short conversations. 用间接引语完成以下对话。

用间接引语完成以下对话。

5 conversations with 10 fill-in items (2 per conversation); item C1 (She said she might not be able to go tomorrow.) is the printed example.

Practice B: About you

Write down three or four things that your family or friends told you yesterday. Make sure you report what was said. 用间接引语形式记录昨天家人或朋友告诉你的三四件事。

Write down three or four things that your family or friends told you yesterday, reporting what was said.

4 open-ended personal writing items: write down one thing that your family or friends told you yesterday, reported in indirect speech. The workbook gives no fixed key; sample answers are suggested.
